scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed verbatim scripts for: Greeting, Closing

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Dead Air Breach: Agent had 2 occurrences of >30s dead air (max gap 36s).

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Paraphrase the customer's core technical issue to reconfirm understanding, e.g., 'Just to make sure I understand, you're experiencing slow internet speeds this morning, correct?'

scorecard.name: Set proper expectations
scorecard.coaching: Clearly communicate the expected duration of any action taken, such as rebooting the router, to set proper expectations with the customer.

scorecard.name: Provided the appropriate solution
scorecard.coaching: The agent should have escalated the issue to a supervisor or a more advanced support team to investigate further and provide a more effective solution, rather than simply suggesting the customer wait it out.

result.summary: Customer reports slow internet, agent troubleshoots, but no resolution found.
